description: This Java class defines an abstract base class for a polyphonic synthesizer voice, including methods for note on/off, mixing the output, rendering sound, and managing state.

classes.name: SynthVoice
classes.description: An abstract class representing a polyphonic synthesizer voice with note control, amplitude, and rendering capabilities.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Activates the voice for a specific note and velocity, setting amplitude accordingly.

methods.name: mix
methods.description: Adds the generated sound output of the voice to a provided output buffer, across multiple samples.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Abstract method to generate the current sample's sound output.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Checks if the voice has finished its sound, based on its current state.

methods.name: getNoteIndex
methods.description: Returns the note index associated with this voice.

methods.name: getAmplitude
methods.description: Returns the current amplitude level of the voice.

methods.name: setAmplitude
methods.description: Sets the amplitude of the voice.

methods.name: setFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Adjusts the frequency scaling factor for the voice.
